# Ellveren
> Ellveren designs, builds and looks after websites for established UK businesses. One point of contact who knows your site, clear monthly plans, and no surprises.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.ellveren.com/) — Your website, in safe hands.
- [Services](https://www.ellveren.com/services) — Website design, web applications, hosting and maintenance, SEO, and paid advertising.
- [Websites](https://www.ellveren.com/websites) — Fixed-price websites from £3,500. Brochure, business, integrated and portal sites.
- [Plans](https://www.ellveren.com/plans) — Monthly website care plans: Static £45/mo, Care £85/mo, Care + Support £235/mo, Care + Growth £385/mo.
- [Managed Website Plan](https://www.ellveren.com/managed-website-plan) — Full-service website at £249/mo + £499 setup. Design, build, hosting, care, and support.
- [Work](https://www.ellveren.com/work) — Recent projects.
- [About](https://www.ellveren.com/about) — Who runs Ellveren and how it works.
- [Contact](https://www.ellveren.com/contact) — Enquiry form.
- [Blog](https://www.ellveren.com/blog) — Tips on web design, SEO, and growing your business online.
- [Terms](https://www.ellveren.com/terms) — Terms of service.
- [Privacy](https://www.ellveren.com/privacy) — Privacy policy.

## Pricing

- **Static plan:** £45/month
- **Care plan:** £85/month
- **Care + Support plan:** £235/month
- **Care + Growth plan:** £385/month
- **Retainer:** from £535/month
- **Managed Website Plan:** £249/month + £499 setup
- **Fixed-price websites:** from £3,500
- **Hourly rate:** £80
- **Prices do not include VAT (Ellveren is not VAT registered).**

## Key facts

- Based in the UK — serves established UK businesses.
- Clients work directly with the person responsible for their site, not an account manager.
- Weekly updates, same-day security patches, daily off-site backups.
- No long lock-ins — your site and content always belong to you.
- WordPress and static sites supported.
